source.datasetName: Renting Out of Flats from Jan 2021

notes: Month = the month HDB approved the rental, not when the lease started or was signed.
Flat rentals approved by HDB; the rents are declared by owners and HDB does not verify them.
No unit numbers, floors or lease dates are available.
Aggregates only: no individual rental is published. Figures need 5+ rentals.
